title: DIFFERENT FARM TOOLS AND EQUIPMENTS
text:
DIFFERENT FARM TOOLS AND EQUIPMENTS

Shovel is a tool used to dig as well as to move loose, granular materials (like dirt, gravel, grain, or snow) from one spot to another.

Spade is a tool used for digging straight-edged holes or trenches, slicing and lifting sod, and edging flower beds or lawns.

Rake is used for scooping, scraping, gathering, or leveling materials, such as soil, mulch, or leaves.

Pitchfork is used to lift and pitch or throw loose material, such as hay, straw, manure, or leaves.

Wheelbarrows are used for a variety of things, such as moving feeds to the barn or collecting manure and other waste out of the barn.

Manual manure scraper is used to clear out lumps of manure for easy rinsing.
